title: Create Compelling Spectacles
coreMove: Turn meaning into image and arrangement so memory grasps it before explanation fades
sourcePressure: Chapter 37 centers on visible form as a way of seizing attention and shaping memory. The law values spectacle because image, symbol, and dramatic arrangement can make meaning feel immediate and difficult to ignore where abstraction alone may fade. Its limit is that spectacle fails when it becomes hollow display, decorative noise, or sensation detached from strategic purpose. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
